name: hanging bone chimes
description: A cord of bones hangs at the southwestern edge of the clearing. Examine it to wind a delayed mechanism: four bursts begin after 20 seconds, then repeat every 15 seconds. It can be wound again after 90 seconds. Hide behind solid cover before the first burst; noise will not make a creature ignore visible prey.

name: loose stone chime
description: A weighted stone chime hangs in the western passage, away from the eastern relic chamber. Examine it to wind a delayed mechanism: four bursts begin after 20 seconds, then repeat every 15 seconds. It can be wound again after 90 seconds. Hide behind solid cover before the first burst; noise will not make a creature ignore visible prey.

name: Behelit among the roots
description: A stone face is knotted into the old oak's roots. Examine it when the guardian cannot reach you.

name: empty oak roots
description: The Behelit is gone. The old roots now hold only stones and dried blood.

name: Behelit in the stone hollow
description: A Behelit lies in a hollow at the center of the cave. Examine it when its keeper is away.

name: empty stone hollow
description: The hollow has already yielded its Behelit.

name: sealed chapel reliquary
description: A red stone face rests inside a cracked reliquary. The butcher guards the approach. Examine the case after defeating or distracting it.

name: silent chapel reliquary
description: The broken reliquary holds only dust. It will yield no Behelit.

name: cracked chapel bell
description: The fallen bell hangs from a frame in the southern nave, far from the northern reliquary. Examine it to wind a delayed mechanism: four bursts begin after 20 seconds, then repeat every 15 seconds. It can be wound again after 90 seconds. Hide behind solid cover before the first burst; noise will not make a creature ignore visible prey.

name: chapel inscription
description: Scratched words cover a stone near the entrance. Examine them to learn what lies farther north.

name: sealed expedition specimen case
description: A stone with a human face rests inside a battered specimen case. A half-demon prowls nearby. Examine the case when it cannot reach you.

name: empty expedition specimen case
description: The specimen case holds nothing but torn packing material. It will yield no Behelit.

name: wind-up emergency siren
description: A hand-cranked siren lies at the southwestern edge of the abandoned tent camp. Examine it to wind a delayed mechanism: four bursts begin after 20 seconds, then repeat every 15 seconds. It can be wound again after 90 seconds. Hide behind solid cover before the first burst; noise will not make a creature ignore visible prey.

name: expedition field log
description: Water-stained pages remain pinned to the camp table. Examine them for the expedition's final observations.
